title: 达到指引还不够：芯片有三年积压，软件销售凭什么跟上？
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: he usually isn't really a buyer of these IPOs because you see that initial pop and then things fizzle out.
segments.zh: 他通常不会真的买入这些新股，因为你会看到初始上涨后便逐渐熄火。

segments.en: I think he put SpaceX as a big example of that here.
segments.zh: 我认为他在这里把SpaceX作为一个重要例子。

segments.en: What sort of, what would entice I guess investors to kind of get back into that space?
segments.zh: 那么，什么会吸引市场参与者重新回到这个领域呢？

segments.en: What do they need to see in order for these kind of big IPOs to sustain those kind of initial rallies?
segments.zh: 他们需要看到什么，才能让这类大型IPO维持住最初的涨势？

segments.en: Well, unfortunately, one of the things I think is a real problem here is there has been such an overperformance in the chip market
segments.zh: 嗯，不幸的是，我认为这里的一个真正问题是芯片市场出现了过度表现

segments.en: over the past, say, eight quarters that right now what investors are looking at I don't want you to just meet guidance I want you to beat guidance by a significant amount
segments.zh: 在过去大约八个季度里，现在市场参与者关注的是：我不希望你仅仅达到指引，我要你大幅超越指引

segments.en: and I think that's very hard in a software sale.
segments.zh: 而我认为这在软件销售中非常困难。

segments.en: It's actually easier in a chip sale because the people that are buying these are looking at three year commit and they're actually creating extensive backlog
segments.zh: 在芯片销售中实际上更容易，因为购买者看重的是三年承诺，并且实际上在创造大量积压订单

segments.en: over the next several years. You don't see that same kind of backlog happening when you're selling software to enterprise this.
segments.zh: 在未来几年里。当您向企业销售软件时，看不到同样的积压订单情况。

segments.en: Interesting. All right, last question Maribob is wondering in terms of 2027, what sort of the recommendations that you would give to client, what would you be recommending in terms of where
segments.zh: 有趣。好的，最后一个问题，Maribob想知道，就2027年而言，您会给客户什么样的建议，您会推荐在哪些方面

segments.en: to look at in this L.A.I. trade for next year now?
segments.zh: 现在来看明年L.A.I.交易中值得关注的点？
